svg.text: C. Relative percentage deviation versus time
Relative deviation is shown only where the measured value is positive; the same rows as figure B
Relative percentage deviation of point values
NO ROW HAS A POINT COMPARISON AVAILABLE
DATA INCOMPLETE rows have no deviation (decision 22)
Model value over upper bound (inequality, not a deviation)
bound reached (ratio 1): above this line the model exceeds the bound
Hollow vermilion triangle pointing down: upper bound exceeded by the model

Relative deviation is undefined for a measured value that is not positive and no near-zero floor is applied, because no row states a detection floor (decision 17); no accuracy threshold is used. A row whose

denominator is not established (DATA INCOMPLETE, decision 22) has no deviation and is not drawn; its measured and model values are in figure A. Upper bounds are inequalities and never enter a deviation; an exceeded

bound is drawn in vermilion whatever the test temperature. Model: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit df8b0b4851d05789a537a40a9ff33510f9ac866a; registered AGR1-B-M16

geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients chosen by the strato-data selection function (register sets C16-T2 and C16-BUF), evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only start; constant temperature;
decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a numerical comparison, not an experimental validation.
